known_blockers: No founder-declared official account, handle, credential reference, or production mandate may be inferred.
No canonical timezone is declared for the 8:00 PM daily edition.
No owned-audience destination or first real offer is declared.
No resource ceiling or stop condition is declared, so the aspiration registry refuses to predeclare the first campaign.
Actual WMI and Kernel runtimes are outside the authorized repository scope.
No real buyer, participant advancement action, platform publication, or payment exists.
This branch and agent/daleobanks-phase1-editorial-control-loop both stack on PR #67 and both rewrite README.md and governance/operating_work_packet.json; those merges are unresolved.
The Phase 1 commits (7c7ba94, ddb7812, de95c17) exist in no reachable git object store, so they cannot be pushed from here.
falsifications: The earlier claim that implementation was blocked by the absence of GitHub CLI is false in this environment because the repository can be cloned and the connected GitHub write path can create branch objects and a draft PR.
A local WealthMachineClient result is not evidence that WMI participated.
A dry-run receipt is not a publication, audience outcome, advancement action, or commercial result.
Repository documentation does not prove runtime implementation.
Correct provenance labeling is not WMI integration. Every assessment in this repository is still a local simulation; the authoritative branch has only ever run against a fake transport.
An executable aspiration registry is not aspiration progress. It is the instrument, and an instrument is not a measurement. VERIFIED_ASPIRATION_GATES_CLEARED is 0 before and after.
Correct provenance labeling is not WMI integration.
Resolving the PR #66 ownership question did not make PR #66 deployable; the kernel packaging gap is unchanged.

The reward function was unguarded: fame is engagement plus followers, penalty counts only reactive platform signals, so rage-bait that avoids a block raises the J-score. The adversarial-controls list named this guard and it did not exist until now.
A complete section 84 deliverable list is not a working business. Every count these systems measure is zero.
Keyword-based content guards are a starting heuristic, not a classifier. Their false-positive rate on real material is unmeasured.
The ladder's guards bind the service path, not the durable store. Direct construction bypasses them; aggregates recompute from source fields so a bypassed record still fails to move a metric.
A closed mandate surface is not a company. 494 tests describe what the institution refuses; none of them describe anyone it has served.
A documented failure posture is not an enforced one. It was documented for the whole session and enforced only at the end.
I found that the optimizer rewards anger, built a guard, and did not connect it. It was unwired for four commits. A guard nothing calls is documentation.
The rage-bait guard is wired and still cannot fire: no per-arm capability or trust telemetry exists. Presence is not protection.

strongest_counterargument: The single most defensible thing built this session spent most of the session disconnected from the mechanism it guards, and now that it is connected it still cannot fire for lack of telemetry. That is the honest state: a complete mandate surface, one live defect identified, and its guard wired but blind. Everything else refuses claims nobody has yet tried to make.
next_smallest_implementation: Two things, in order. Collect per-arm capability and trust deltas so the outrage guard can actually fire — that is code and needs nothing from Alfonso. Then the six declarations.

publication_authority_ownership: RESOLVED as composition, not conflict. PR #66 Reality Aperture is the constitutional gate (Kernel signs; Aperture.__init__ accepts no signer). Phase 0/1 account prerequisite, editorial review, CapabilityGrant, and KillSwitch are organ-local policy. They compose in series and organ-local refusal runs after Kernel authorization: a certificate permits, it never compels. Recorded PROPOSED, not IMPLEMENTED — PR #66 imports the aperture from a sibling kernel checkout and skips its tests when absent.
